# Kotlin fact counters (.kt, .kts), for a rule with the shared prompt file-body-oop: one per line,
# label TAB pattern (Java regex), counted over the whole file. The [ignore] line runs first and reads
# the file as the Kotlin lexer does, leftmost region first: it blanks line comments, block comments
# (nested, as Kotlin nests them), raw strings ("""...""") and string and character literals with their
# ${...} templates, so a "fun" or "class" in a KDoc, a string or a commented-out block does not count.
# A comment or raw string that is never closed runs to the end of the file, a string or character
# literal to the end of its line. "type declarations" counts a named class, interface or object,
# not an object expression (object : Runnable {) that starts a line. "functions (approx)" counts
# every fun declared at the start of a line (members, top-level, local and extension functions), not
# a fun interface; "extension functions" a fun whose name has a receiver type, its type arguments nested
# one level (Map<String, List<T>>.f), as an annotation's arguments may nest one level
# (@Deprecated("x", ReplaceWith("y()"))); "secondary constructors" a constructor that starts a
# line, after annotations (@Inject constructor(...) : this(...)) and a visibility, not the primary
# constructor on the class's line (class A @Inject constructor(...)), but one wrapped onto the next
# line; "constructor properties" every val or var after "(" or ",", also after vararg, final,
# override, expect, actual and a visibility, which is a primary constructor's property and, rarely, a lambda's
# destructuring, but not the subject of a when (val y = ...). Counts are regex heuristics: a
# declaration that starts after another on the same line, or a string template nested more than one
# level, is not read as the compiler reads it. JvmFactPatternsTest pins every case;
# ProfileFactPatternsLinearityTest measures that every pattern reads linearly.
[ignore] comments and string literals
type declarations
companion objects
data classes
sealed types
functions (approx)
extension functions
suspend functions
secondary constructors
constructor properties (approx)
const vals
lateinit properties
imports
